items.raw_excerpt: Diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer at 26, Anunya "Bo" Asavavetin has now lived with the disease for five and a half years. After surgery, radiation and numerous treatment regimens, she continues to live day by day with hope and purpose. She has become an author, singer and actress, and is now helping launch the Be That Light Project, which will sell products and donate proceeds to cancer patients.
items.summary_en: Anunya 'Bo' Asavavetin was diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer at age 26. She has lived with the disease for five and a half years while working as an author, singer and actress. She now helps run the Be That Light Project, which sells products and gives the money to cancer patients.
